# Eye Level Learning Center of Hicksville

> Neighborhood Math and English tutoring center in Hicksville, New York. Franchise location of Eye Level (Daekyo).

## Business facts

- Name: Eye Level Learning Center of Hicksville
- Address: 760 S Broadway, Hicksville, NY 11801
- Telephone: 516-597-5300
- Hours: Tuesday to Friday, 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM; closed Sunday and Monday
- Programs: Math (basic arithmetic and critical-thinking math), English (reading, and writing in narrative, informational, opinion, and research forms), Summit of Math
- Grades: Pre-K through Grade 12 (emphasis on elementary and middle school)
- Method: diagnostic level test, step-by-step curriculum, one-to-one coaching for self-directed learning
- Primary CTA: book a free level test and consultation
- Canonical site: https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com
- Service area: Hicksville, Plainview, Bethpage, Syosset, Jericho, Westbury, Levittown, Old Bethpage

## Principal pages

- [Home](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/): Overview, process, FAQ, consultation form, map
- [Math Tutoring](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/math-tutoring-hicksville/): Math program details for Hicksville
- [English Tutoring](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/english-tutoring-hicksville/): Reading and writing program details
- [Free Level Test](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/free-level-test/): How to book the diagnostic assessment
- [Parent FAQ](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/faq/): Scheduling, grades, comparisons, tuition process
- [Contact](https://www.myeyelevelhicksville.com/contact/): Address, hours, phone, form, map
